LoRAOptimizerSimple.description: Analyze, optimize, merge, cache, and apply a LoRA Manager stack.

model.name: Model
model.tooltip: Base model that receives the optimized LoRA patches.

lora_stack.name: LoRA Stack
lora_stack.tooltip: LoRA stack supplied by LoRA Manager or another compatible stack provider.

output_strength.name: Output Strength
output_strength.tooltip: Final merged strength; -1 lets the optimizer choose a safe value.

clip.name: Clip
clip.tooltip: Optional text encoder for LoRAs that contain CLIP patches.

clip_strength_multiplier.name: Clip Strength Multiplier
clip_strength_multiplier.tooltip: Strength multiplier applied to merged CLIP patches.

settings.name: Settings
settings.tooltip: Optional LoRA Optimizer Settings; recommended defaults are used when disconnected.

LoRAOptimizerSettings.description: Configure merge strategy, memory, caching, compression, and advanced optimization.

auto_strength.name: Auto Strength
auto_strength.tooltip: Automatically reduces excessive combined LoRA strength.

optimization_mode.name: Optimization Mode
optimization_mode.tooltip: per_prefix automatically chooses the best merge strategy for each model area.

sparsification_density.name: Sparsification Density
sparsification_density.tooltip: Fraction of weights retained when sparsification is enabled.

patch_compression.name: Patch Compression
patch_compression.tooltip: smart preserves exact low-rank results; aggressive also compresses nonlinear results.

free_vram_between_passes.name: Free VRAM Between Passes
free_vram_between_passes.tooltip: Release unused CUDA cache between analysis and merge passes.

strategy_set.name: Strategy Set
strategy_set.tooltip: Limits which merge strategies automatic mode may select.

normalize_keys.name: Normalize Keys
normalize_keys.tooltip: Normalize LoRA keys produced by different training tools.

architecture_preset.name: Architecture Preset
architecture_preset.tooltip: Model-family hint used by automatic strategy selection.

auto_strength_floor_mode.name: Auto Strength Floor Mode
auto_strength_floor_mode.tooltip: Use the architecture-aware floor or the manual value below.

auto_strength_floor.name: Auto Strength Floor
auto_strength_floor.tooltip: Lowest multiplier auto-strength may apply in manual mode.

decision_smoothing.name: Decision Smoothing
decision_smoothing.tooltip: Encourages similar layers to use consistent merge strategies.

smooth_slerp_gate.name: Smooth SLERP Gate
smooth_slerp_gate.tooltip: Use a smooth decision boundary when selecting SLERP.

vram_budget.name: VRAM Budget
vram_budget.tooltip: Maximum fraction of VRAM used to retain completed patches; 0 keeps them in RAM.

cache_patches.name: Cache Patches
cache_patches.tooltip: Keep one completed merge in memory for instant reuse during this ComfyUI session.

persistent_cache.name: Persistent Cache
persistent_cache.tooltip: Save completed merge patches under the ComfyUI user directory so they can be reused after a restart. Disable to prevent local cache files from being read or written.

star_eta.name: STAR Eta
star_eta.tooltip: Per-LoRA STAR spectral cleaning; 100 disables it.

tame_layers.name: TAME Layers
tame_layers.tooltip: Strength of base-weight-aware magnitude taming; 0 disables it.

tame_threshold.name: TAME Threshold
tame_threshold.tooltip: Delta-to-base norm threshold used by magnitude taming.

SaveMergedLoRA.description: Save optimizer output as a reusable safetensors LoRA.

lora_data.name: LoRA Data
lora_data.tooltip: Connect the lora_data output from LoRA Optimizer here.

save_folder.name: Save Folder
save_folder.tooltip: Which loras folder to save into. Lists configured lora paths from ComfyUI and extra_model_paths.yaml.

filename.name: Filename
filename.tooltip: Name for the saved file. Subdirectories are allowed (e.g. 'merged/my_lora'). Extension .safetensors is added automatically.

save_rank.name: Save Rank
save_rank.tooltip: 0 = auto: uses the sum of all input LoRA ranks (e.g. 3 rank-32 LoRAs → rank 96). Non-zero = compress all layers to exactly this rank via SVD. Use a non-zero value to reduce output file size — set it to match your largest input LoRA's rank or lower. Higher values = more accurate but larger file.

bake_strength.name: Bake Strength
bake_strength.tooltip: When enabled, the saved LoRA reproduces your exact merge when loaded at strength 1.0. When disabled, strengths are not baked in — you'll need to set the strength manually when loading.

prompt.name: Prompt
prompt.tooltip: Example prompt or trigger words to embed in the file metadata. Useful for sharing — some UIs display this automatically.

description.name: Description
description.tooltip: Optional description or notes about this merged LoRA. Stored in file metadata.
